items.question: Which three temporal classes of beings are named by these three participial forms?
premises: patiṣyatām denotes beings yet to fall
items.inference: The verse names falling, fallen, and future-falling beings.
uncertainties: Exact syntactic relation to the preceding hell-suffering clause is not explicit in the supplied tokens.
items.plain_english: Of those falling, those fallen, and those about to fall.
